description: Revoke public artifact links, either by share id or every link of the artifacts you name, so the links stop working at once. The artifacts stay. Reports how many links were revoked and which ids were not yours or not found; copies others already made cannot be recalled. Requires signing in (artifacts:write).

artifactIds.description: Artifact ids whose every link is revoked, 1 to 50. Send this or shareIds, not both

shareIds.description: Share ids from list_artifact_shares, 1 to 50. Send this or artifactIds, not both

name: revoke_artifact_shares
title: Stop sharing artifacts
